Context: 3. Date of Birth and its subsequent alteration

- (iii) 16th of that month of the year.
2. Entry of Date of Birth in Service Records.The actual date or assumed Date of Birth determined as above will be recorded in the Service Book or other Service Records. Once entered, it cannot be altered, without prior order of Head of Department, except in the case of a clerical error.
